purpose: Track currently verified free BGM/SFX sources, their usage constraints, attribution requirements and acquisition limits so future media work can build a large reusable audio pool without violating site rules or silently becoming paid.

sources.name: YouTube Audio Library
sources.notes: YouTube states Audio Library music and sound effects are copyright-safe for YouTube; Creative Commons tracks require attribution, while some standard-license tracks do not. Recheck track-level terms before use and do not assume the same rights outside YouTube.

sources.name: DOVA-SYNDROME / OpenTracks transition
sources.notes: Audio may be used as background under the site license, including YouTube/TikTok, but creator-specific conditions may apply. Site terms prohibit bot/programmatic collection. Download manually or by a user-directed non-bot flow and preserve the license snapshot. Downloaded tracks may remain usable after later removal when the license permits.

sources.name: 効果音ラボ
sources.notes: Commercial use is currently allowed without credit. Redistribution of raw or modified sound files is prohibited. Store locally only for production use and never expose a raw downloadable sound library to end users.

sources.name: OtoLogic
sources.notes: Materials are currently offered under CC BY 4.0; commercial use and modification are allowed with attribution. Preserve attribution metadata with each asset.

sources.name: MusMus
sources.notes: Commercial and monetized YouTube use is currently allowed for BGM use. Copyright/credit display is required for free use. Do not redistribute the music itself or register the music into Content ID.
